assets.rightsBasis: Official DSCET crest served from the college's own domain (dscet.ac.in) and used on its site. No open licence; used only to identify the institution. Checked 2026-10-23: HTTP 200, image/png, 273,706 bytes, 523x477 px, black line art on a transparent background. Rendered on white and visually confirmed legible: a ring reading 'Dhanalakshmi Srinivasan College of Engineering & Technology' and 'Chennai' around a quartered shield (torch, folded hands, lotus, open book) above a ribbon reading 'Learning for Excellence'. Although the file is named favicon1.png, it is a full-size crest (523x477), not a 16/32 px favicon. Alternative wide colour lock-up (crest plus 'DHANALAKSHMI SRINIVASAN COLLEGE OF ENGINEERING AND TECHNOLOGY (An Autonomous Institution) ECR, MAMALLAPURAM, CHENNAI') at https://dscet.ac.in/assets/images/logo.png (471x100 px, transparent, legible on white) was not chosen because it is only 100 px tall and does not suit square tiles.

Official institutional photograph used as the homepage banner on the college's own domain (dscet.ac.in). No open licence; used only to depict the institution. Checked 2026-10-23: HTTP 200, image/jpeg, 228,506 bytes, 1920x800 px (landscape). Visually confirmed as a single real elevated photograph, not a composite or AI image: the arched entrance gate reading 'Dhanalakshmi Srinivasan College of Engineering and Technology', a basketball court, the glass-fronted four-storey main block with the college name board, further blocks and hostels behind, and a row of yellow college buses; no text overlay or watermark; no identifiable people. Rejected: assets/images/slider/4.jpg (graduation-day stage with identifiable people), assets/images/about/1.jpg (portrait of the chairman), assets/images/25.png (generic '25 years' badge).
assets.altText: Elevated view of the entrance arch, basketball court and main academic block of Dhanalakshmi Srinivasan College of Engineering and Technology on East Coast Road, Mamallapuram
